visualScope: 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-11: all 453 source units checked against original identities and source-byte fingerprints. All 326 slides visually reviewed. All sampled source frames of the 125 previously unreviewed videos inspected in sequence, including final frames; changing-caption boundaries checked on native neighbouring frames. The two prior approved videos and all 19 baseline reviews were preserved. V2 re-extracted 434 unreviewed units using local Windows OCR, actual timestamps, sampling up to 4fps and complete retained transcripts. This is a visual transcription audit, not full playback/frame-by-frame certification of all videos, fact-checking of source claims, or an OCR accuracy percentage.

findings.issue: Sampled frames show the same 'BARE MINIMUM' paragraph, but OCR creates 27 variants. Several bottom lines are corrupted or missing, including 'makes time for me', 'deep conversation' and the final quoted line; the headline emoji is also missed.
findings.action: Verify the entire original, then consolidate the complete static paragraph into one block. Restore the lower lines, punctuation and headline emoji; remove the spurious standalone '1'.
findings.resolution: Creator captions visually transcribed; all 54 sampled frames inspected in source order, including final frame. Static caption consolidated into one complete block; numeric values, punctuation and emojis checked against full-size source. Timing ends at video stream duration. App UI, generated app-demo copy and screenshot excerpts excluded. Source claims were not fact-checked.
